lab.quote: For at least this financial year, we are covered with internal accruals and the cash on the balance sheet.

lab.quote: Yes, so we have seen some movement in yarn prices and that would have to be transferred to the customer. So, we will maintain our gross margins and prices might go up in the future by 3%-4%.

call_memory.statement: Prices might increase by 3% to 4% in the future to pass on raw material yarn price inflation to customers.

lab.quote: It's about Rs. 2.6 crores and it will increase because of the price increase. So, it will become around Rs. 2.7 crores-Rs. 2.8 crores now. That includes CAPEX and inventory. So, the CAPEX would be about Rs. 1.2 crores-Rs. 1.3 crores and the rest would be paid inventory.

lab.quote: So, it's all because of product mix... the price ASP increase within the category is only inflationary. I think that would be around 4% to 5%. But everything else is attributed to a different product mix.

call_memory.statement: Depreciation in Q4FY26 included a one-time accounting hit of Rs 6 crores to Rs 7 crores from fully expensing small operational items like nuts, tags, and hangers.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹797.02 Cr, net profit ₹17.51 Cr.
V2 Retail reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹797.0 Cr and net profit of ₹17.5 Cr, taking total stores to 325.
V2 Retail Limited’s **Chairman & Managing Director Chandra Agarwal** and **Ram Chandra Agarwal** disclosed the Q4 FY26 earnings call audio link (May 29, 2026) on the company website.
V2 Retail reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹797 Cr and PAT of ₹17.5 Cr, closing the year with 325 stores.
